title: Let listening become your wealth
summary: Patience, glory, and honor gather around the one who keeps listening to the Name, making delay a place of inward trade rather than resentment.
takeaway: Spend the waiting hour by listening until patience becomes the wealth you carry out.
lifeApplication: At the next delay, give your ears to Naam before resentment begins its story; let the waiting become a small exchange of hurry for honor.

source.shortMeaning: Patience and honor come to those who listen to the Lord's Name.
source.lifeApplication: At the next delay, listen before resentment narrates the wait.
